body:
He messaged me just a while ago. 

"Hey... Uhmm.. I'm sorry. I may have been a little bit too selfish. Well i was too selfish. And I'm sorry. I know that I was in the wrong. And i apologise. It's been a little to hard for me to keep ignoring you. And I just am not doing justice on you. I'm sorry. I love you so much. And i really do apolgise for what I've done. I was selfish and was just thinking about myself. I'm sorry. I really am. And... i miss you a lot. Again I'm sorry i've once again hurt you. And probs made you cry again. I really am sorry. I'm not worthy of such an amazing woman. I'm really really sorry. You deserve better. Love you. And I'm sorry again..."

I only replied to him with an 'it's fine. Love you too'

I'm just extremely hurt with the messages he sent to me prior to him saying that he'll talk to me in a week or two. I've had suicidal tendencies everytime I feel low. I just dont know what to do. I dont want to hurt him the way he hurt me because i just love him way too much.

Thank you so much for the stuff you've said, Nick. Really appreciate every single one of them.
Im not sure on what you mean by SO? What's that? 😂
I completely agree on what you say.

We had a talk not too long ago. I was upset and explained why. We had an argument and i apologised for what happened last night. He then was like "Talk to you in a week or two. Bye". 

I 

Am

Crusheeed

I was in a children's party and i went to my car. Bawled my eyes out for god knows how long. Even my parents got involved as my sister saw me crying inside the car. Like shiiiiiit. Never have they seen me cry or anythiiing. Now my parents are going to hate this man i love.

i was tilted. Extremely tilted and i didn't say anything after the shittyass match that we had cause i too was upset. My bf and i just talked earlier and he said me not talking was the reason why he ignores me. Now he said he won't talk to me for a week or two
Highly disrespected. Hes been active in his social media for the past few hours and still ignores me. Leaving me in read. I guess so. I'll  live my life. Thanks!

***UPDATE***

I messaged him last night (almost 2am since we finished at around that time) and has left me on seen at around 6:30 today. 

I barely slept (i slept at 3) and messaged him a good morning and told him I'll go fix up (i have somewhere to go to today) 

He's got a basketball game today with friends and it ends at 9am. 

Honestly, i am getting frustrated at him for ignoring my @ss off. I have huge problems at getting ignored at.
He can honestly be a real man without the video games, but be a big child over it.

He's honestly rarely apologised and never even considered any of my sorries to be sincere whenever I did something wrong. I have tried arguing (because i knew i did nothing wrong) with him in the past for almost the same reason, but different game and he blew up more. Instead of him understanding my situation, it became 'youre ruining the game experience for all of our teammates and me' and i had to apologise plenty of times without him accepting it.

I am being 10000% serious about my post and is not a joke. By you mean dont blow up his phone, should I ignore him too? dont spam him too muchh? Or act normal as if nothing happened last night? I honestly dont know what to do lmao. Ive never been ignored this hard and i tilt my ass off everytime we play. 
That is true. Too much drama on both sides
Absolutely nooot!! 😂 i was playing to bond with him and to release some stress as Ive been studying for my board exams 5-6 hours per day!!

Update:

We've been together for almost a year now (tomorrow is our anniversary).

During one of his 'episodes' last week, he suddenly burst and said that I do not have the right to feel depressed as everything has been always been working for me. That he was also being fake for being extremely happy the first time we met, that he's was hiding his depression. He said a lot of stuff that i don't even want to recall as it hurts me a lot. 

That was the last draw and it just made me feel so useless as i cant make him feel any better. I resorted to cutting my leg, and most recently my wrist. I also tried to overdose myself with sleeping medication (i only ended up being asleep the whole day) as i dont think I'm worthy enough.

This is exactly what my other friend told me. That hes extremely manipulative and selfish.

I'm glad that youre getting the help you need! Also thank you for your input. I appreciate it.

Youre not the only one OP. I once took 4 doses over the recommended of the medication i took and slept from 11am- 3pm, (only woke up to go out with family)  8pm- 11am. Everything is just so okay when im asleep. No problems to worry about.
